title: Outbound OAuth connections & GitHub/Google org admission
summary: Added Tier A (agent-held, X25519-sealed) and Tier B (host-brokered, client-wrapped) outbound OAuth connections plus admin-signed GitHub Org/Team and Google Workspace group admission with automatic offboarding.
body: Use `@tendriller/core/connections`, `shared/helpers/connections.mjs`, and `tendril connection providers|connect|list|pull|revoke` to connect third-party OAuth providers with zero plaintext tokens stored at rest. Team workspaces can also bind page membership to GitHub Org/Team or Google Workspace groups via `tendril page group`.
